argv:
set -e
A=products/actors/rss-reader
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='products/actors/rss-reader/src/core.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    if _DTD.search(data):
        raise FeedError("dtd_rejected", "DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations are refused (entity expansion disabled)")
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,'''    # No byte-level DOCTYPE scan: real feeds embed "<!DOCTYPE" inside CDATA HTML (github.blog does).
    # Refusal happens in the expat DTD/entity hooks, which only fire on a real declaration.
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 -I $A/tests/run_tests.py
